stories.title: Videos challenge the Trump administration's account of the Minneapolis killing
stories.summary: Videos and eyewitnesses appear to contradict the Trump administration's account of the Minneapolis killing, prompting accusations of excessive force and state concerns about a federal investigation they say is excluding them.

stories.title: The border flow slows to a trickle as asylum cases in Mexico drag on for months
stories.summary: Barred from the US, stranded in Mexico: migrants at the border have faced uncertainty and stalled asylum claims.

stories.title: Widespread outages follow weekend freezing rain, with more ice ahead
stories.summary: A massive winter storm brought freezing rain and widespread outages in the South, with icy conditions lingering in the North through Monday.

stories.title: A rare snowfall sends Tulsa sledders to the hills
stories.summary: In Tulsa, Oklahoma, the snow brought out sledders and creative rides, even in extreme cold.

stories.title: A CrossFit-like race is booming in Asia, and young people are driving the surge
stories.summary: Hyrox, a timed fitness race that mixes running with workout stations, is selling out across Asia as young people fuel a booming wellness economy.

stories.title: Where is the threat from Russia and China in the arctic?
stories.summary: As Trump points to Russia and China near Greenland, experts say the biggest Russian and Chinese activity is elsewhere in the Arctic.
